# CBDB-Desktop label review: conventions and decisions

Running summary for the review of HTML labels against the MS Access FormLabels table, form by form in alphabetical order. Done on 2026-10-26: Association Pairs, Associations, Browser (checked by the user 2026-10-27, no problems). Done on 2026-10-27: Entry, Group Data, and a second pass on the first three forms against the updated table ("Association Pairs, Associations and Browser label revisions, second pass"). Done on 2026-10-28: Kinship ("Kinship label revisions (Oct 28 2026)"), Networks ("Networks label revisions (Oct 28 2026)"), Office ("Office label revisions (Oct 28 2026)"), Places ("Places label revisions (Oct 28 2026)"), Status ("Status label revisions (Oct 28 2026)") and Texts ("Texts label revisions (Oct 28 2026)"). **Texts was the last form with FormLabels rows; every form with rows has now been reviewed.** What remains is the cross-form list under "Open across forms" below. Also on 2026-10-28: the Query Builder (QBE), which has no FormLabels rows, was given the same language switch and full Chinese ("Query By Example (QBE) translation (Oct 28 2026)").

## Which FormLabels table

**From 2026-10-27, the reference is the updated FormLabels (643 rows) from the user's current CBDB database (FormLabelsUpdated.xlsx).** The first three forms, and the first pass of Entry, were reviewed against an older 330-row copy that had only BIO, BROWSE, LAA, LAAP, LAE, LAN, LAO and the subform codes. The updated table adds LAG, LAK, LAP, LAS, LAT, KRW, POT, SF_BID and SF_BSD. It also adds rows to every query form and corrects several rows (詢查 → 查詢 in LAA 5, LAAP 9, LAE 5 and LAO 5; Pakej → Pajek in LAA 7 and LAAP 11; LAE 4 Pick → Select Entry), and fills in the c_jianti columns in simplified characters. All forms reviewed so far have been checked against it.

## Working method

- FormLabels is the reference, but it has errors and obsolete rows; correct obvious mistakes and record them.
- c_jianti = simplified, c_fanti = traditional. Either column sometimes holds characters from the other script (e.g. 類别 in c_fanti, 代碼 in c_jianti) or from Japanese (関); convert them. Checking each form's rows by script conversion (OpenCC) catches these.
- **Regional usage (user's ruling, 2026-10-27):** where Taiwan and mainland usage differ, the traditional labels use the Taiwan term and the simplified labels the mainland term (匯出 / 导出, 儲存 / 存储), even where the table gives one word for both.
- **Where the table's English differs from the HTML's, the table's English is used.** Exceptions: where the HTML's wording is clearer about what a control does, it is kept and the Chinese is rewritten to match (user, 2026-10-28; Places relation categories); abbreviations forced by the Access layout are written out ("Use Person Addr" → "Use Person Address", "Max Ancestor Gen." → "Max Ancestor Generations"); buttons that every form names the same way keep that name ("Run Query", "Save to GIS") when one form's row differs.
- Rows for Access-only controls (language toggles, Exit/Close, Help, GBK/ASCII/Pinyin/Big5 export, data-entry buttons, options the HTML doesn't have) are listed as not used, not added.
- HTML labels with no FormLabels row are kept, translated where untranslated, and listed in the report.
- Each form gets a report with before/after values in all three languages and the translation key, so any label can be reverted after testing. Refs run LBL-1, LBL-2 … across forms; the latest is LBL-119 (Texts). Form-specific fixes have their own prefix (AP-, GRP-, ENT-, KIN- …).
- Where a form's labels are keyed by number (Kinship used the VBA's indices, which did not match the LAK rows), they are given named keys like the T objects on the other forms, so the numbers can't be mistaken for FormLabels rows.
- **Disabled labels (cbdb_styles.css):** CSS-1 greys a label that follows its disabled checkbox; CSS-2 (2026-10-28) greys a label immediately before a disabled number box (label:has(+ input[type="number"]:disabled)); CSS-3 (2026-10-28) greys a label that wraps its disabled checkbox (label:has(&gt; input[type="checkbox"]:disabled)) and gives .btn-clear a disabled style. Use &lt;label for&gt; directly next to its input so these rules apply.
- **Clear buttons** (All Places, All Texts, All Offices …) are disabled until their picker returns a selection, and disabled again when clicked (Texts TXT-6, Places PLC-7).
- **SQL terms stay in English** in every language where the user types them or sees them in the SQL (QBE, user 2026-10-28): the Group drop-down ((none), Group by, Count …), join types (Inner, Left, INNER JOIN), Distinct, VIEW, NULL, and Criteria syntax (Like, Between, In, And, Or). Headings and tooltips around them are translated. The Sort options are translated (遞增 / 遞減, 升序 / 降序; user 2026-10-28) since nobody types them.
- Small related bugs (untranslated buttons, controls missing an id, enable/disable behaviour) are fixed and recorded. On every form with an address filter, Sub-units and Use XY are enabled only when a place is selected, with checkbox + &lt;label for&gt; markup so the disabled-label rule greys them.
- Reports are supplied as Markdown in the project and as Word files, named like "CBDB-Desktop -- Entry (Look At Entry) label revisions 2026-10-27.docx" (no colons, which Windows doesn't allow in file names).

## Wording decisions

| Item | Traditional | Simplified | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Run Query | 查詢 | 查询 | Table (all forms); ▶ kept |
| Save to … (file export) | 保存于… | 保存于… | Table; 于 in both modes; replaces 存至…, 儲存至… and 保存到… (also Save to KML, no row); LAN 53–57's 保存: … not used (decided at Networks) |
| Save [codes] (file) | 保存… | 保存… | e.g. Save Entry 保存入仕法 (LAE 33) |
| Store Person IDs | 儲存人物代碼 | 存储人物代码 | Table has 存儲人物代碼 in c_fanti; 儲存 is the Taiwan term (regional-usage rule) |
| Person IDs stored (note after storing) | 已儲存人物代碼 | 已存储人物代码 | No row (Kinship KIN-1) |
| Recall Person IDs | 召回人物代碼 | 召回人物代码 | Table (LAAP 22, LAK 28, LAN 75, LAG 2); replaces 調出ID |
| Person ID(s) | 人物代碼 | 人物代码 | BIO 58 |
| Import … | 輸入… | 输入… | Table (輸入人名, 輸入地名, 輸入入仕法 …) |
| Export … | 匯出… | 导出… | No table rows; 导出 is the mainland software term |
| Code | 代碼 | 代码 | Not 代號 |
| Type (category) | 類別 | 类别 | LAE 3 etc. (類别 corrected) |
| Index Year(s) | 指數年 | 指数年 | Table; 指數, never 索引 |
| Use Index Years | 利用指數年 | 利用指数年 | Table |
| No Dates | 無時限 | 无时限 | Table |
| Use Dynasties | 利用朝代 | 利用朝代 | Table |
| From / To (year boxes) | 始年 / 終年 | 始年 / 终年 | Colons kept where the label precedes an input |
| From / To (dynasty range, Access only) | 始於 / 終於 | 始于 / 终于 | Not used while the HTML has a multi-select dynasty picker |
| Select Place | 選擇地名 | 选择地名 | Table |
| All Places | 所有地名 | 所有地名 | Table; also the button that clears a place filter |
| Include Subordinate Units | 含下轄行政區 | 含下辖行政区 | Table; replaces 包含下級單位 / 子單位 |
| Use XY References | 按經緯度查詢 | 按经纬度查询 | Table |
| Status | 社會區分 | 社会区分 | Table (BIO 52, LAG 10, LAS 9) |
| Office(s) / Postings | 職官 | 职官 | Table (BIO 53, LAG 11) |
| Entry (record type) | 入仕 | 入仕 | Table (BIO 47, LAG 12) |
| Select Dynasties | 選擇朝代 | 选择朝代 | No row |
| Display Language: | 顯示語言： | 显示语言： | Table has an ASCII colon; full-width kept |
| Colons in Chinese labels | ： | ： | Full-width (e.g. Person count 人物數量：) |
| ← Navigation | ← 導航 | ← 导航 | Translated on every form (decided 2026-10-27); id lnkNavigation, key navigation; replaces "← Home" where a form had it |
| Kinship step columns (Up / Down / Collateral / Marriage) | 先世值 / 後世值 / 旁系值 / 姻親值 | 先世值 / 后世值 / 旁系值 / 姻亲值 | SF_KIN 8–11; also LAN 66–69, LAK 4–7 |
| Kinship step limits | 先世值≤ / 後世值≤ / 旁系值≤ / 姻親值≤ | 先世值≤ / 后世值≤ / 旁系值≤ / 姻亲值≤ | LAK 4–7, LAN 66–69; English "Max Ancestor Generations:", "Max Descendant Generations:", "Max Collateral Links:", "Max Marriage Links:" |
| Mourning Circle | 五服 | 五服 | LAK 3; replaces 服制圈 |
| Restrict to Place | 按地方限制查詢 | 按地方限制查询 | LAN 78; replaces Limit Search by Place |
| Include Kin / Non-Kin / Male / Female | 包括親屬關係 / 包括社會關係 / 包括男性 / 包括女性 | 包括亲属关系 / 包括社会关系 / 包括男性 / 包括女性 | LAN 9–12 |

| Max Node Distance: / Max Loops: | 距離限制： / 循環數限制： | 距离限制： / 循环数限制： | LAN 7, 8; 循環, not 迴圈 |
| Association categories | as LAN 16, 19–52 | as LAN 16, 19–52 | CBDB's association vocabulary (官場平等關係, 薦舉保任, 學術襄助, 書札 …); Writings group 著述; Select All 所有類別; "All …" checkbox for every group |
| Networks results tabs | 社會網絡 / 社會關係人 / 綜合多種社會關係 | 社会网络 / 社会关系人 / 综合多种社会关系 | LAN 17 (plural: Social Network Relationships), 18, 64; English length to check |

| Office postings tab | 任官記錄 | 任官记录 | User, 2026-10-28, against LAO 10's 官名; People in Office tab 人名 (LAO 11) |

The four descriptive English labels are the HTML's, kept over LAP 15–18 with Chinese to match (user, 2026-10-28) |
| Index address (指數地址) | 指數地址 | 指数地址 | Used in descriptive labels, e.g. 親屬指數地址 |
| Places tabs | 人地關係 / 綜合人地關係 / 於地址有關係的人 | 人地关系 / 综合人地关系 / 于地址有关系的人 | LAP 31–33 |
| Status people tab | 有社會區分的人 | 有社会区分的人 | LAS 10 has 社會關係的人 (copied from LAA 11); pattern of LAT 10 (有文本角色的人); confirmed by the user 2026-10-28 |
| Selection summaries | 未選擇… / 多選（N項） | 未选择… / 多选（N项） | e.g. Status: 未選擇社會區分; no rows |
| Biographical sources (Texts query mode) | 傳記出處 / 僅主要出處 / 僅本人傳記 | 传记出处 / 仅主要出处 / 仅本人传记 | 出處 BIO 55; 主要出處 SF_BSD 5; 本人傳記 SF_BSD 4 |
| Select Text / All Texts | 選擇文本 / 所有文本 | 选择文本 / 所有文本 | LAT 4 (Select Text Category) not used: the picker selects texts too |
| Texts tabs | 文本與人物角色 / 有文本角色的人 | 文本与人物角色 / 有文本角色的人 | LAT 9, 10 (Texts and Roles / People) |
| QBE terms | 範例查詢, 資料表, 欄位, 聯結, 準則, 群組, 選取清單, 工作區, 按兩下, 拖曳 | 示例查询, 表, 字段, 联接, 条件, 分组, 选择列表, 工作区, 双击, 拖动 | Taiwan / mainland database-software terms; full glossary in the QBE report |
| Use Office Years | 利用任官年份 | 利用任官年份 | LAO 39 |
| Save Offices / People to GIS (KML) | 保存官名于GIS / 保存人名于GIS (KML) | same | LAO 6, 7; KML no row |
| Aggregated (aggregate labels) | 綜合 | 综合 | User, 2026-10-28; not 總合; applied to LAN 64 and LAP 32 |
| Kinship results tabs | 被檢索者相關的親屬網絡 / 親屬網絡 / 親屬網絡的人 | 被检索者相关的亲属网络 / 亲属网络 / 亲属网络的人 | LAK 23, 22, 31 (Ego-Relative Kinship Network / Kinship Network / People) |
| Import / Clear list of people | 輸入人名 / 刪除人名 | 输入人名 / 删除人名 | LAAP 19, 20; LAG 1 |
| Page titles | CBDB: 查看… | CBDB: 查看… | "CBDB: " + form name in all three languages (user, 2026-10-28; Chinese scholars also say CBDB); English form names "Look At …", not "Looking at …" (user, 2026-10-28; LAN 60 has Looking at); ASCII colon after CBDB; 查看, not 瀏覽 (LAN 60); Group Data keeps 按人群查詢; e.g. CBDB: 查看親屬關係 |
| Language buttons | EN / 繁 / 简 | EN / 繁 / 简 | Fixed text on every form; no 體 (user, 2026-10-28) |
| Display Language: label | 顯示語言： | 显示语言： | Every form has one before the language buttons (user, 2026-10-28) |
| Basic Information (Browser tab) | 基本資料 | 基本资料 | Replaces 生卒年 |
| Social Institutions | 社會機構 | 社会机构 | User's decision 2026-10-27, against the table's 社交機構 (BIO 54, LAP 13) |
| Profile (Export Profile) | 人物資料 | 人物资料 |  |
| Pinyin / Chinese column pairs | X拼音 / X | X拼音 / X | e.g. 別名拼音 / 別名漢字 (SAN 4, 5) |
| English / Chinese description pairs | X(英文) / X | X(英文) / X | Pattern of SF_POS 5 |

- English capitalisation: follow the HTML's own style where the table differs only in case.
- Results-tab names and Chinese form names: the user is content with the existing ones where the table has no row (2026-10-27). Where the table has rows (LAG 21–25, LAK 22, 23, 31), they are used.
- Not wanted (user, 2026-10-28): Rerun Query Using Results (LAN 73), replaced by Store Person IDs + Recall Person IDs; Simplify Kinship Terms (LAK 32, with the KRW 1–2 warning), an experimental Access feature too unreliable to keep, possibly to revisit later; Exclude Ego (LAK 33), dormant; Import / Save code lists where a form lacks them (e.g. LAO 37–38), dormant unless the steering committee asks for them; Export Options headings (the old ASCII / UTF-8 choice; every export is now UTF-8), removed; Help buttons, removed until help files exist for the new version (the Access version had PDF help per form; Status STA-5).
- "Allow 1-node Intermediaries" (LAAP 3) is unnecessary; Events and Possessions tabs are omitted because those tables have effectively no data.

## Corrections to suggest for FormLabels:

- **LAAP 24:** 保存為 UCINet 格式 → 保存于UCINet.
- **LAN 53, 54, 56, 57:** 保存: … → 保存于….
- **LAN 64:** c_fanti 總合 and c_jianti 綜合 disagree; c_jianti also has traditional 綜, 種.
- **LAN 77:** Use XY Reference → Use XY References.
- **LAS 10:** 社會關係的人 → 有社會區分的人 (copied from LAA 11).
- **LAP 32:** 匯總 / 汇综 disagree. **LAP 34:** 类別 → 类别 in c_jianti.
- **LAO 3:** 類别 → 類別 in c_fanti. **LAO 10:** Offices Postings → Office Postings.
- **BIO 54, LAP 13:** 社交機構 → 社會機構.
- **Store Person IDs rows:** 存儲 → 儲存 in c_fanti, if the table should follow the regional-usage rule.
- **Script slips in c_jianti:** 代碼, 無時限, 刪, 終 and 関, as listed in each report. (No slips in the LAK rows; LAN 16, 19 have 類別 → 类别 with traditional 別.)
- **KRW 1–2:** English text in both Chinese columns (rows not used).

## Open across forms:

- **Page titles** are fixed text on Associations and Browser. Check every form's title against the "CBDB: Look At …" pattern (Entry's Chinese title, 查看入仕途徑 — 中國歷代人物傳記資料庫, doesn't follow it yet), and that every form has a Display Language label and EN / 繁 / 简 buttons.
- **Results-table headers** on most query forms are hard-coded.
- **Status and other messages** are English only.
- **Colons:** Entry's From / To / Code labels still have ASCII colons in Chinese; the other forms now use full-width.
- **Clear buttons on earlier forms:** check that All Places / All Dynasties etc. on Entry, Associations, Association Pairs and Group Data are disabled until something is selected, as now on Places, Status and Texts.
- **Placeholders** ((none), (all texts), 中文, year …) are English or fixed Chinese on every form.
